sentences.en: "I observed it when you entered the chamber," Holmes said.
sentences.zh: “当你进入那个房间时我就观察到了它。”福尔摩斯说。

sentences.en: Air provides considerable thermal insulation when trapped in a chamber.
sentences.zh: 当空气被困在一个密闭的空间里时，可以提供相当好的隔热效果。

sentences.en: Many small business owners belong to a chamber of commerce.
sentences.zh: 许多小企业主都加入了商会。
